summary: Note that the PowerShell support dates are based on current schedules and may change; PowerShell 7.8 is expected in preview when ansible-core 2.24 ships in November 2027.
questions: Are the PowerShell support dates for Ansible guaranteed?
Will PowerShell 7.8 be GA when ansible-core 2.24 releases?

answer_card.title: PowerShell date caveat
answer_card.answer_md: The PowerShell dates are based on current Ansible and PowerShell schedules and may vary. PowerShell 7.8 is expected to still be in **preview** when ansible-core 2.24 releases in November 2027, with general availability around November to March.
